What is Ansible Health?

Ansible Health unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from premier institutions like Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, and Amazon to revolutionize care for patients with polychronic conditions, particularly those with a cardiopulmonary focus. We merge elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team\'s groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, underscores our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we\'re a well-funded Series A startup partnering with leading health systems, payors, and providers nationwide. Our mission is genuinely improving patient outcomes through data-driven care, not just optimizing metrics. If you\'re passionate about transforming healthcare through technology and data, join our diverse team in making a tangible impact.

The Job at a Glance

We are seeking an exceptional Data Scientist to join our innovative team. In this role, you will develop and deploy sophisticated machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions to transform patient care for complex cardiopulmonary conditions. You\'ll leverage clinical, operational, and device-generated data to build predictive algorithms that support clinical decision-making, optimize care pathways, and improve patient outcomes.

Working at the intersection of healthcare and cutting-edge data science, you\'ll collaborate with our interdisciplinary team of clinicians, engineers, and researchers to translate scientific insights into practical applications. Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to predict clinical outcomes, identify at-risk patients, and optimize treatment protocols for polychronic cardiopulmonary conditions

  • Build and deploy natural language processing solutions to extract valuable information from unstructured clinical notes and medical literature

  • Develop time-series models to analyze continuous monitoring data from medical devices and wearables, identifying early warning signs of patient deterioration

  • Create and validate clinical decision support algorithms that provide actionable insights for healthcare providers

Qualifications

  • Master\'s degree or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field

  • Proven experience applying machine learning and statistical modeling to solve real-world problems, preferably in healthcare or life sciences

  • Strong programming skills in Python, including proficiency with scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, pandas) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)

  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models in production environments

  • Advanced knowledge of statistical analysis, experimental design, and causal inference

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with healthcare data, particularly EHR systems, medical imaging, or clinical time-series data

  • Knowledge of FHIR standards and healthcare interoperability frameworks

  • Familiarity with cardiopulmonary conditions, respiratory care, or chronic disease management


What We Offer
